answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the ocean forfeiture exposes up in the plume totals with the gale audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 41% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 225 aliases after a single epoch as a result destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
